Name: Jonathan the Scribe
Summary: Jonathan the scribe owned the house that was made into a prison where Jeremiah was beaten and held for many days; Zedekiah later had Jeremiah brought from Jonathan's house and kept him in the prison court instead. He is a different man from Jonathan, son of Saul.
KeyStory: The princes put Jeremiah in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe, where he remained many days until the king moved him to the court of the prison.
LifeLesson: A scribe's house turned into a prison is a picture of what happens when law serves power instead of truth.
